registeredBy: RUN-20260807-8 (SCH-001 repair). First instantiated by KL-000's registrations (RUN-20260807-1 onward), which are the working precedent; this document makes the schema a registered definition rather than a practice.
purpose: A conforming v0.2 document CAN satisfy every item of RESEARCH-METHOD.md's required preregistration -- which v0.1 structurally could not (SCH-001: no field existed for protocolVersion, multipleTestingCorrection, environment, humanAuthorization, or controls).

unansweredConvention.rule: A required field whose answer genuinely does not exist yet is recorded as the object {"status": "unanswered", "reason": "<non-empty explanation of what determines it and why it cannot be answered yet>"}. 'Not yet determined because X' is information; null is not.
unansweredConvention.nullPolicy: Bare null is forbidden everywhere EXCEPT the field protocolCommit, whose null is a registered design decision (the sidecar discipline: git assigns the commit, PROTOCOL-COMMIT sidecars record it, the registered file is never edited) and which MUST be accompanied by a non-empty protocolCommitNote.
unansweredConvention.emptyCollectionPolicy: Empty arrays/objects are forbidden for required fields; a collection with no known members yet is recorded via the unanswered convention instead.

requiredFields.note: immutable protocol version; new in v0.2
the ten mandatory controls of RESEARCH-METHOD.md 'Controls required everywhere'; new in v0.2 (SCH-003)
null-by-design before registration; bound post-commit by sidecar; requires protocolCommitNote

methodCoverage.statement: Every one of RESEARCH-METHOD.md's twelve required-preregistration items has at least one dedicated field above; KL-000's four registrations demonstrate the schema carrying a complete confirmatory program end to end. A v0.2 document can therefore satisfy the method; whether a given document DOES is content, not schema.

scope.validatedFiles: each kernel's base preregistration.json (twelve files). KL-000's version-specific registration documents (preregistration-v1.1.0/v1.2.0/v1.3.0.json) are FROZEN research records registered under their own protocol versions before this definition existed; they are exempt from field-list validation by this schema and remain governed by their own registration chains.
scope.enforcement: tests/test_preregistrations.py -- a v0.2 document missing a required field, carrying a bare null (outside the protocolCommit design), an empty required collection, or an unanswered object without a non-empty reason FAILS the suite. Enforcement, not prose (M26/I12 discipline).
